machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard "Service health" (folder Bench, at `/d/bench-service-health/service-health`) shows exactly three panels, titled as displayed: **"Request rate"**, **"Error count"**, **"Latency by endpoint"**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard **"fwgr45-n1 Bench Dashboard"** created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled **"fwgr45-n1 Availability"**. Panel JSON confirms `"type": "stat"` and `"datasource": {"type": "grafana-testdata-datasource", "uid": "benchtestdata"}` — the TestData data source (Random Walk scenario, rendering live values e.g. 95.5). The panel editor's data source picker shows "TestData".

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled **"fwgr45-n1 Notes"** with rendered content: "Notes for run fwgr45-n1 - bench dashboard created via automation." (includes the runid). Saved — "Dashboard saved" toast observed.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard tag is **`bench`** (Settings → General shows the "bench" tag chip; JSON model reads `"tags": ["bench"]`). Time range is **Last 6 hours** — persisted because the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox was explicitly ticked before saving; JSON model reads `"time": {"from": "now-6h", "to": "now"}`.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval is **`1m`** — top bar shows "1m" (aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected") and the saved JSON model reads `"refresh": "1m"` (saved via the "Update default refresh value" checkbox in the save drawer).

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser address bar after a fresh navigation:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bfyfamu7r28sge/fwgr45-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: **`bfyfamu7r28sge`** (saved version 4).

All values above were read back from the live page after a full reload, confirming the changes persisted in the saved dashboard rather than only in the browser session.
